title: Review Report
description:
An independent code review of one development commit, made inside the prototype loop.

The reviewer is not the developer. It reads the committed build and returns a verdict: `approve`, or `request-changes` with the blockers the next development visit must fix. The verdict is the reviewer's; everything else in this record is measured by the Factory - which commit was reviewed, how long the review took, whether it timed out, and whether the reviewer left the checkout exactly as it found it.

A reviewer is read-only on the game repository. That is enforced, not requested: the checkout is fingerprinted before and after the review, and any difference fails the review, is listed under `isolation.violations`, and is undone. A review that could not be trusted - isolation broken, verdict malformed, reviewer timed out or crashed - records `verdict: no-verdict` and a `failure`, never an approval. `skipped` means no reviewer is configured: no review happened, and nothing downstream may read it as one.

reviewed_commit.description: The commit the review was of: the checkout's HEAD, which must equal the prototype-report's build_ref.commit_sha.

baseline_commit.description: Where the development visit that produced reviewed_commit started. The change under review is baseline..reviewed.

verdict.description: approve and request-changes are the reviewer's. skipped: no reviewer is configured. no-verdict: the review ran but produced nothing that can be trusted; see failure.

blockers.description: Empty for approve. Non-empty for request-changes: a request for changes that names none cannot be acted on.

argv0.description: Basename of the reviewer executable. Never the full argv: it may carry a prompt or a credential path.

status.description: How the process ended: exited, timeout, idle-timeout, cancelled, not-started.

checked_paths.description: Files fingerprinted in the checkout and the Factory's guarded paths.

intact.description: True when the before and after fingerprints are identical.

sensitive.description: package manifest, lockfile, test, CI or tool configuration.

restored.description: After a violation: whether the checkout and guarded paths were put back to their pre-review state. null when there was nothing to restore.

iteration.description: The workflow visit to the review step.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or null for a finding about the build as a whole.
